product.name: Cadence
product.one_line: Cadence turns a team's deploy pipeline into a single readable timeline: define stages as code, watch them run, gate the risky ones behind a real approval.

audience.primary: engineers and eng leads on small-to-mid teams who currently stitch deploys together from CI YAML, chat pings, and tribal knowledge
audience.state: mildly burned by a flaky or opaque deploy process; skeptical of another dashboard; will judge this page by whether it reads like it was built by people who ship, not by people who sell

outcome: primary: install the CLI and run a first pipeline locally; secondary: read the docs / view an example pipeline file

action.primary_cta_mechanism: copyable install command, not a signup form — this is a dev tool, the CTA respects that

voice.humor: dry, occasional, never at the cost of clarity

honesty_constraints: no fabricated adoption metrics (no 'trusted by N teams', no invented customer logos)
a real code example (pipeline YAML) stands in for social proof instead of unverifiable claims
any number shown must be a mechanical/config fact (e.g. a stage count in the example), never a marketing metric
